settings.description_subheading: BOMBER SYNERGY EDGE CORNHOLE BAGS – PROFESSIONAL DUAL-SIDED CORNHOLE BAGS WITH EDGE TECH
settings.description_eyebrow: OFFICIAL TOURNAMENT CORNHOLE BAGS – MADE & ENDORSED BY THE AMERICAN CORNHOLE ASSOCIATION
settings.description_body: Take your cornhole game to the next level with Bomber Synergy Edge Cornhole Bags, featuring patented EDGE Tech construction (Patent Pending) for superior control, blocking, and shot accuracy. These dual-sided, regulation-size cornhole bags are designed for both precision and speed, with a microsuede slow side for grip and a poly turbo weave fast side for smooth slides. The innovative three-piece construction creates a flatter landing surface for even weight distribution, improving shot consistency. Show off your bold style with the Bomber Synergy Edge cornhole bags, featuring a striking design that brings attitude to every toss.
settings.closing_paragraph: Designed for players of all levels, Synergy Edge Cornhole Bags bring professional performance to backyard games, tournaments, and competitive play. Whether you're blocking your opponent or landing the perfect airmail shot, these innovative cornhole bags deliver precision, durability, and unmatched gameplay.

settings.feature_text: Officially approved cornhole bags by the American Cornhole Association (ACA)
Designed for precision and consistency, Bomber Synergy Edge cornhole bags offer a reliable feel and standout style on the boards.
Dual-sided performance: Grip with microsuede, slide with poly turbo weave
EDGE Tech patented construction enhances blocking, pushing, and control
Flat design for even filling dispersion – no more unpredictable landings
Resin-filled for all-weather durability – lasts longer than traditional cornhole bags
Double reinforced stitching ensures a long-lasting, tournament-quality build
Regulation size & weight: 6in x 6in and ACA-compliant

settings.heading: NEW! GAME CHANGING EDGE TECHNOLOGY
settings.subheading: Bomber Synergy Edge bags give you the edge with Edge Technology stitching. Shop the Synergy Edge Cornhole Bags for your chance to experience the new difference in bag technology.

settings.heading: GET AN EDGE OVER THE COMPETITION
settings.description: With as many as four Edge sides to choose from, the Synergy Edge brings a new level of bag customization and control to cornhole competitions.

settings.question: What makes the Synergy Edge so Special/Different?
settings.answer: The Synergy Edge features Edge Technology stitching that creates two distinct playing surfaces on each side of the bag, giving players unprecedented control over speed and stick.

settings.question: When is the Synergy Edge best used?
settings.answer: The Synergy Edge is ideal for competitive play where precision and control are essential. It performs in any weather condition.

settings.question: How does the patented Edge Band work?
settings.answer: The patented Edge Band provides an extra grip zone on the bag that allows for more consistent release and improved bag trajectory.

settings.question: How did the Synergy Edge get its name?
settings.answer: The name Synergy Edge reflects the combination of premium materials working in harmony with the new patented edge stitching technology.

settings.question: Is the Synergy Edge good for beginning cornhole players?
settings.answer: Absolutely. While the Synergy Edge is a competitive-level bag, the dual-surface design helps beginners learn control faster.

settings.question: Are Bomber Edge bags ACA approved?
settings.answer: Yes. All Bomber Synergy Edge bags are ACA (American Cornhole Association) approved for all sanctioned events.

settings.question: What kind of warranty do Synergy Edge bags have?
settings.answer: Bomber Synergy Edge bags come with a 30-day risk-free satisfaction guarantee.
